claims.statement: The executable bootstrap creates the platform core and application, and the core owns GLFW, OpenGL2, ImGui, ImPlot, frame polling, rendering, viewport restoration, and shutdown while invoking the app callback each frame.

RfSimulatorApp invokes CircuitRuntime::update() before drawing UI; the runtime rewires component inputs and updates engines in graph topological order, after which the app resolves probe output ports for the spectrum UI.

Signal routing uses raw const Spectrum pointers in SignalNode inputs and owned Spectrum outputs, so component removal must rewire surviving inputs before same-frame consumers dereference them; multi-output routing preserves the selected output index.

ComponentRegistry owns live engine instances and maintains view, graph-node, and type_index indexes with rollback when registration fails; ComponentTypeRegistry separately owns canonical type descriptors and dispatch for factories, labels, inspectors, persistence, and authoring.

ProjectSerializer owns .rfsim save, load, and reset orchestration, persists links and probes as component-index and port references rather than raw pin IDs, and restores components before links and probes.

Project loading validates JSON shapes and integer representability, skips malformed sibling records with stable -1 mappings, and removes partially restored components on nested failure instead of retaining half-created state.
Project S-parameter paths and library data-file paths are constrained to their owning roots, with project saves relativizing contained paths and rejected paths neutralized or ignored.

Extension manifests are untrusted filesystem input: manifest paths must resolve inside the extension root, invalid manifests stay visible with validation issues, duplicate menu entries with the same location and label are rejected, and external tools run only through an explicit JSON request and result exchange with bounded result files.

The Network Analyzer is a singleton instrument rather than an IComponentEngine or graph node; it discovers the forward measurement chain between its two points with findMeasurementChainPath(), runs that chain on private clones driven by a synthetic tone-comb stimulus, and reuses its result while the path signature and sweep settings are unchanged.

SessionState, LayoutManager, and TutorialState own separate persistence concerns: window visibility, exe-relative ImGui layout and presets, and exe-relative tutorial completion respectively, rather than project circuit data; SessionState persists to app.ini only on Windows and is a no-op elsewhere.

The Test Flow harness owns flow parsing, validation, and sweep execution. The Test Flow panel and the test_flow_run agent tool share RunFlowWithinBoundary, which snapshots every engine, runs the sweep, restores each snapshot independently, and rewires; the panel refuses sweeps above its row limit and latches a restore failure until the circuit is reloaded.

CircuitRuntime owns the live graph, component registry, view manager, and component-ID counter; it validates connection pins and link policy before committing, rewires after connect, disconnect, and removal, and rewires before topological engine updates.

EditorCommands centralizes user-level edit side effects and revision-based dirty tracking: accepted project edits advance the revision, rejected edits do not, component-set changes synchronize views, and probe or selection changes retain their non-revision semantics.

Receiver Requirements is an app-level measurement consumer rather than a graph component: while visible, RfSimulatorApp updates the Network Analyzer once per frame, feeds the receiver-performance engine the Point A and Point B pins and sweep, evaluates gain, noise-figure, output-power, and IIP3 limits, and draws the result in its panel; the configured requirements persist in the project file.
The agent layer reaches application behavior only through IAgentHost, which AppAgentHost implements, and RfSimulatorApp pumps queued agent calls at the start of each frame's update.
Agent circuit edits go through EditorCommands, and the agent test_flow_run tool runs through RunFlowWithinBoundary, so agent calls reuse the app's edit and run boundaries.

The Network Analyzer and the receiver output-power and IIP3 measurement both obtain their measurement chain from findMeasurementChainPath(), and the agent measure and receiver tools use the same discovery.
CircuitRuntime advances its epoch only when clearComponentsAndResetIds() resets the circuit, and agent results carry the current epoch so clients can detect stale state.
A successful save, load, or New records the clean revision through EditorCommands::markClean().
The release history records 0.26.0 moving graph and component ownership into CircuitRuntime and 0.27.0 adding receiver output-power and IIP3 requirements.
CircuitRuntime's header and implementation include no ImGui, ImPlot, or ImNodes headers.
Saving writes a sibling .tmp file, checks write, flush, and close, and renames it over the target only after success.
